title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligations

description.narrative:
The Government of Guyana has requested support to review the functioning of the labour legislation except for the one on occupational safety and health and on maritime labour. Such review is expected to contain issues in law and practice, and recommendations to address them. The review result will be submitted to the Tripartite Committee for further steps, such as drafting.
Beneficiaries of this initiative include workers, employers, their and the broader community in Guyana, who will benefit from updated and clearer labour legislation. The work will be done in collaboration with the Government of Guyana (especially the Ministry of Labour, the Ministry of Legal Affairs and Chambers of the Attorney General), the Tripartite Committee, and other national stakeholders. The ILO will provide technical support.
